form: present middle/passive participle, masculine nominative singular
meaning: striving, desiring, eager (with middle voice: striving for oneself)
etymology: From Proto-Indo-European *yeh₁- (to throw, send); the middle voice developed the sense of 'to hasten, strive eagerly'
in_context: The participle modifies the subject (Odysseus), expressing his intense desire or eagerness despite which (περ being intensive) he could not save his companions
